meta.desc: Explore how Phirez configures Trimble GNSS, DJI Enterprise drone LiDAR, and Esri GIS for mining, civil construction, cadastral administration, utilities, and precision agriculture.

intro.t: Tailored Geospatial Workflows For African Industry

Every sector faces unique physical, regulatory, and topographical demands. We configure specialized hardware, analytics, and lifecycle services to ensure maximum accuracy and operational return on investment.

imgs.alt: GNSS survey equipment set up on an active construction site.

intro.t: Six Sectors. One Certified Partner.
From open-pit mines to disaster-response zones, we engineer workflows that match the terrain, regulation, and risk profile of each sector we serve.

imgs.alt: DJI Enterprise drone surveying a quarry pit for volumetric auditing.

ps: Overcome the hazards and slow turnaround of manual pit surveys. Phirez equips mining companies with autonomous drone LiDAR for rapid stockpile volumetric reconciliation, Trimble robotic total stations for highwall slope deformation monitoring, and Carlson Mining software for drill-and-blast design.
lis: Volumetric Auditing: Monthly cut/fill calculations with sub-5cm accuracy using DJI Matrice 350 RTK & Zenmuse L2.
Pit Wall Safety: Continuous deformation and prism monitoring with Trimble S-Series robotic stations.
Mine Geology Modeling: Carlson Geology & Mine Design software integration.

imgs.alt: Civil engineering survey team with Trimble GNSS on an active road site.

ps: Deliver complex linear corridors and structural bridges strictly within engineering tolerances. We supply Trimble R12i GNSS receivers, machine control positioning systems, and 3D laser scanners that allow site engineers to verify as-builts directly against 3D BIM models in real time.
lis: Corridor Stakeout: High-speed road centerline & batter stakeout with Trimble Access Roading.
Structural As-Built Verification: Trimble X7 3D laser scanning for bridges, culverts, and tunnels.
BIM Interoperability: Seamless point cloud import into Autodesk Civil 3D and Revit.

imgs.alt: Phirez survey team conducting geodetic control survey with Trimble GNSS on tripods.

ps: Accurate land records are the foundation of national economic development. Phirez establishes national and regional geodetic control networks (CORS), executes legal cadastral boundary surveys, and configures Esri ArcGIS Enterprise land registry databases for municipal and government authorities.
lis: CORS Network Establishment: Multi-frequency reference stations for continuous RTK corrections.
Boundary Formalization: Sub-centimeter Trimble GNSS static and RTK parcel surveys.
Spatial Land Registries: Secure, searchable parcel databases built on Esri Parcel Fabric architecture.

imgs.alt: Technical GIS presentation on asset management for utility corridors.

ps: Protect existing underground assets and model overhead networks. We combine US Radar Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) for detecting buried pipes and fiber optic cables with drone LiDAR for mapping high-voltage transmission line vegetation clearances.
lis: Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE): Triple-frequency GPR scanning eliminates strike hazards.
Transmission Line Modeling: Aerial LiDAR identifies tree encroachment and conductor sag.
Asset Geodatabases: Esri Utility Network deployment for water, power, and telecom operators.

imgs.alt: Field demonstration of precision agricultural drone at a sugarcane plantation.

ps: Maximize crop yields and monitor forest concessions with precision multispectral drone analytics. Phirez delivers multispectral mapping to generate NDVI plant vigor indices, identify irrigation failures, and optimize variable-rate fertilizer distribution across large agricultural estates.
lis: NDVI Crop Scouting: Detect crop stress and disease weeks before visible to the naked eye.
Prescription Mapping: Generate automated variable-rate spraying and fertilizer application maps.
Forest Biomass Estimation: High-density drone LiDAR measures tree canopy height and timber volume.

Mobile Survey Workflows: Offline field data collection for humanitarian needs assessments.

cards.h: Aerial Drone Photogrammetry & Quarry Volumetric Auditing

imgs.alt: Aerial survey crew setting up a drone at a commercial aggregate quarry.

ps: Manual aggregate inventory reconciliation traditionally means surveyors climbing hazardous rock stockpiles with GNSS poles — slow, and a real safety risk.
A DJI Matrice 350 RTK drone with a Zenmuse L2 LiDAR sensor flies automated terrain-following lines. Point clouds are classified in DJI Terra and cut/fill volumes calculated in Carlson Mining.
Faster survey turnaround with no personnel exposed to unstable stockpile terrain, and volumetric outputs suitable for inventory reconciliation and audit reporting.

cards.h: Multispectral Drone Imagery for Precision Crop Health Optimization

imgs.alt: Agricultural drone demonstration over a commercial sugarcane estate.

ps: Commercial sugarcane plantations applying uniform blanket fertilizer treatment risk over-fertilizing fertile sectors while under-treating compromised blocks.
High-resolution multispectral drone flights generate Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) analytics in ArcGIS Pro, producing prescription variable-rate application maps by block.
Targeted, data-driven fertilizer application in place of blanket treatment — reducing input waste and supporting healthier, more consistent crop stands.

imgs.alt: Phirez International team members at an industry event in Kampala.

intro.t: A Decade & A Half Of Spatial Innovation

Phirez International Limited was founded in Kampala in 2011 with a singular objective: to elevate the standard of spatial data collection, engineering survey, and information technology infrastructure across Uganda and East Africa.

Over the past fifteen years, we have grown into Uganda's foremost geospatial authority — serving as an Authorised Distribution Partner for Trimble Geospatial, an Esri Silver Partner, and an enterprise specialist for DJI Enterprise drones. We bridge advanced global positioning technology with the practical realities of African infrastructure delivery.

imgs.alt: Phirez survey team with Trimble GNSS receivers on Archer Road Kampala.

intro.t: Our Core Pillars & Principles
We believe in long-term relationships backed by unwavering technical integrity and transparent engineering standards.

ps: We measure our success in millimeters. From geodetic control networks to drone LiDAR point clouds, we deliver data that engineers trust without hesitation.
Doing what is right for our clients, our team, and our partner brands. Transparent pricing, genuine OEM parts, and honest technical feasibility assessments.
We invest heavily in factory training and local laboratory calibration facilities so that our clients never have to ship instruments overseas for routine service.
We walk beside our clients throughout the working life of their systems — from initial selection and financing advice to ongoing HelpDesk field support and certified training.

intro.t: Our Core Technical Divisions
Our team comprises registered geodesists, commercial UAV pilots, certified GIS architects, and factory-trained instrument technicians.

Architecting enterprise GIS databases, web mapping portals, and automated mobile data collection workflows for national ministries, UN agencies, and utility networks.
Maintaining optical collimator test benches and EDM baselines in Kampala to service and certify surveying instruments, coupled with blended practical training masterclasses.
